newsitem.title: CHINA: Yuan ends down against US dollar in Shanghai.
newsitem.headline: Yuan ends down against US dollar in Shanghai.

text.p: The Chinese yuan closed down at 8.2920 on Tuesday from Monday's 8.2914 against the U.S. dollar in Shanghai on a technical correction, traders said.
The weighted average price on Monday was 8.2917.
Dealers said the correction was expected after the yuan closed sharply up on Monday.

The yuan opened lower at 8.2917 and moved up to hit an intraday high of 8.2914 early in trading. It then fell slightly to move around 8.2920 for the rest of the session, hitting a low of 8.2925 a few minutes ahead of closing. Trading was dull with most business done at 8.2918, traders said.
One dealer said the yuan lacked the momentum to rise further after Monday's heavy gains.
"A correction was expected as a result," he said.
A second dealer said a wait-and-see sentiment dominated the market on Tuesday, making trading slow.
"Traders were cautious with the yuan now standing close to two-year highs, waiting for market-moving news such as foreign trade statistics," he said.
Dealers said they expected the yuan to move around the 8.2920 level on Wednesday.
The yuan closed slightly up at 7.1150 from 7.1202 against 100 Japanese yen and down at an intraday low of 1.0710 from 1.0702 against the Hong Kong dollar.
